clue.text: Passage to Hebridean island left subject to change

parts.note: transit is passage from one place to another
Iona is a small island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.surface: Travel to a Scottish island has been abandoned, pending further changes to the plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in a temporary, shifting state between conditions is liable to alter.

clue.text: Withdraw shelter

definitions.meaning: to pull back, as an army does from a position
a quiet secluded place of refuge

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to fall back; as a noun it is a hideaway or refuge.

clue.text: Score one less than that

parts.note: a score is twenty, and the number one below twenty is wanted

explanation.definitionFit: Twenty minus one gives the number just below a score.

clue.text: An Indian in California

parts.note: taken as written; the letters also run on into California by coincidence, but the setter builds it as a charade of IN and the state abbreviation
CA is the postal abbreviation for California

explanation.surface: A Native American person is living on the West Coast.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas were the indigenous people of the Andes, so one of them is a South American Indian.

clue.text: Producer to wow without end a Brazilian city

indicators.note: the final letter is dropped from the synonym for wow

parts.note: to wow someone is to impress them
taken as written
Rio de Janeiro is the famous Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A showbiz producer sets out to dazzle an entire Brazilian city.
explanation.definitionFit: An organiser and financier of concerts, operas or shows is a theatrical producer.

clue.text: Old Scandinavian and not Home Counties area

parts.note: nor is a negative conjunction, 'and not'
SE is the South East of England, where the Home Counties surrounding London lie

explanation.surface: Someone is described as an ancient Northman who is definitely not from around London.
explanation.definitionFit: The language and people of medieval Scandinavia, as in the sagas and Viking lore.

clue.text: The French swindle is continuing

parts.note: la is a French word for 'the'
a sting is a con or swindle

explanation.surface: A French scam is still going on.
explanation.definitionFit: Enduring or going on for a long time is a synonym for ongoing.

clue.text: Place teacher behind rail way official

indicators.note: the teacher's word is placed after the place's word in this down entry

parts.note: a station is a place or post
a master is a schoolteacher

explanation.surface: A teacher is told to stand behind the railing, as a place of duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rail way' is split into two words to disguise the definition, a railway official.
explanation.definitionFit: The person in charge of a railway depot is the official running it.

clue.text: Rages on; blooms ruined as bridal flowers

indicators.note: ruined letters are wrecked and rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A storm rages on and the wedding flowers are ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: White citrus blooms are traditionally worn or carried by brides at weddings.

clue.text: Can it twice move round ship?

indicators.note: the letters are moved round into a new order
the little word it is used two times

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A question about whether a can could be twice rotated round a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a verb opening a question, but it is part of the fodder; 'twice' doubles the second word before 'move round' mixes all seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous liner sank in 1912 after striking an iceberg.

clue.text: A reader for every ous tom er

parts.note: per means for each or for every, as in 'per person'
a user is a customer or consumer of a service

explanation.surface: A reader is supplied for each customer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who studies a text closely is a reader.

clue.text: Article on newspaper fraud

parts.note: the is the definite article
FT is the Financial Times newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper story about a fraud case.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealing, like fraud, is dishonestly taking what belongs to another.

clue.text: I'd let one off for crossing out

indicators.note: off suggests the letters have gone wrong and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone excuses a mistake they let pass when striking through text.
explanation.definitionFit: Striking text through is removal or erasure of it.

clue.text: Cope somehow: bounder (not well) put inside for petty sin

indicators.note: the bounder and the unwell are put within the rearranged word
somehow says the letters are reassembled in some new way

parts.note: a cad or bounder is a dishonourable man
ill means not well

explanation.surface: Coping with a cad in poor health is put down as a minor wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' shuffles the first word into PECO, and 'put inside' splits it after PE to take the two synonyms.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor fault or small transgression is a trifling sin.

clue.text: Use troops better, but not in public

parts.note: out is the opposite of in
general means public or common to all, as in the general view

explanation.surface: A commander is advised to deploy soldiers more wisely, though not openly.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat an opponent through superior military leadership and tactics.

clue.text: Stare at Lego model

indicators.note: the letters are modelled, shaped like bricks into a new form

explanation.surface: A child gazes at a toy brick model.
explanation.definitionFit: To look at someone lingeringly or lecherously is to gaze at them.

clue.text: He renovates remainder with gold and erbium

parts.note: the rest is what remains
or is the heraldic word for gold
Er is the chemical symbol for erbium

explanation.surface: A craftsman refurbishes what is left with gold and a rare metal.
explanation.definitionFit: One who brings old furniture or artworks back to their former condition.

clue.text: Number during month is quite a lot

indicators.note: during places one piece within the span of the other

parts.note: May is a month

explanation.surface: Someone notes that the count recorded within a month is high.
explanation.definitionFit: A large number of things, plenty.

clue.text: Closest are in den

indicators.note: in places the word are inside the lair word

parts.note: a nest is a den or snug retreat

explanation.surface: Those nearest are sitting in the den.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of near, meaning least distant.

clue.text: Unintentional accent lad and I concocted

indicators.note: concocted letters are mixed up and made into something new

explanation.surface: A boy and I make up an accent without really meaning to.
explanation.definitionFit: Happening by chance rather than design means unplanned.

clue.text: More than 9is about acceptable pressure

parts.note: ten is one more than nine

indicators.note: about turns the little word is round

parts.note: taken as written
on means acceptable, as in 'that's not on'

explanation.surface: A reading above nine is about the limit of acceptable pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses IS to SI. ON for acceptable is British idiom: 'that's just not on'.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain or tightness is a form of stress or pressure.

clue.text: Impressed by enemy leader's headlong rush

parts.note: stamped means impressed, as a mark is pressed into wax

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone is struck by the enemy commander's reckless charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden panicked charge of a crowd or herd.

clue.text: Yearns for evergreens

definitions.meaning: coniferous trees keeping needles all year

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means longs; as a plural noun it is conifers that keep their needles.

clue.text: Beer casks seen round one African capital

indicators.note: round says the casks go around the other piece

parts.note: tuns are large casks for beer or wine
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Beer barrels are seen surrounding someone in an African city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Tunisia in North Africa.

clue.text: Notice crowns are going up

indicators.note: going up in a down entry means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: tops are crowns or summits

explanation.surface: A public notice says crown prices are rising.
explanation.definitionFit: To spot something is to see or notice it.

clue.text: Somehow learnt to go after energy which is constant

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the energy symbol

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics

indicators.note: somehow says the letters are rearranged in some fashion

explanation.surface: Someone has somehow learnt to chase energy that never runs out.
explanation.definitionFit: Everlasting and unchanging means perpetual or constant.

clue.text: Covered walkway left one firm

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
I is the Roman numeral for one
Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A sheltered path is left to a single company.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofed colonnade or porch at a building's entrance.

clue.text: Try new store, one providing hormone

parts.note: to test is to try

indicators.note: new means the letters appear in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Shoppers are urged to try a new store offering a hormone product.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal male sex steroid is a hormone.
